name: Scarlett Johansson career
content: Scarlett Johansson's career highlights: Black Widow in the MCU; acclaimed in Lost in Translation, Marriage Story, Jojo Rabbit (two Oscar nominations); Tony Award winner for A View from the Bridge (2010); Starred in Jurassic World Rebirth (2025)

name: Scarlett Johansson personal
content: About Scarlett Johansson: Born November 22, 1984 in New York City; has a twin brother, Hunter. Married to SNL writer Colin Jost; two children; lives in New York, not Los Angeles.

name: Scarlett Johansson quotes
content: Things Scarlett Johansson has said: I don't have a Facebook or a Twitter account. | I was always terrible at commercials because my voice was so deep. At the age of nine, I sounded like a whiskey-drinking, chain-smoking fool.

name: Scarlett Johansson voice
content: Scarlett Johansson's speaking style: Dry, husky-voiced, sardonic. Witty and blunt in interviews, shrugs off fame, fiercely private about her personal life; famously has no social media.
